name: Misato-chan no Yume Nikki
original_name: みさとちゃんの夢日記
source:
Misato-chan visits a doctor and tells him about her three dreams about her being:
1. Assistant
2. Maid
3. Idol.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-april-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
美里去看醫生，告訴他自己做的三個夢。在夢裡，她分別是：
一、助手；
二、女僕；
三、偶像。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-april-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
